title: ericoides lanatum
intro: Ericoides lanatum, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the Northern Hemisphere. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat urinary tract infections and improve kidney function due to its diuretic and astringent properties. The health benefits of Bearberry include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry include arbutin, a glycosidic compound that is responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
